name: Teamboard
idea: A lightweight task board for small teams: projects hold tasks, tasks move across To do / Doing / Done, and teammates comment on them.
features: Create projects and invite teammates by email
Create, edit, assign and move tasks between To do, Doing and Done
Filter a project's board by assignee and status
users_auth: Email and password sign-up with JWT bearer tokens. Two roles per project: owner and member.
entities: task: project_id, title, description, status, assignee_id, due_date
deployment: Docker images deployed to Fly.io; GitHub Actions for CI
